item.description:
Today’s Study Note
#

1. Introduction to Multiple linear regression
#

1.1 purpose of learning
#

  • Describe Multiple linear regression
  • Compare Multiple linear regression and simple linear regression
  • List the pitfalls of multiple linear regression

1.2 What is Multiple Linear Regression
#

  • Extension of simple linear regression
  • Formula: \(\hat{y} = \theta^{T} \mathbf X\)
  • Require independent variables

1.3 Comparison
#

  • MLR better model than SLR
  • Too many features make it easy to overfit

1.4 “What-if” scenario Pitfalls
#

  • Inaccurate findings:
    • considering impossible scenario
    • extrapolating scenario
    • model might depend on a group of correlated or colinear variables

1.5 Solution to correlation Pitfalls
#

  • Remove redundant variables
  • select variables which are:
    • Most understood
    • Controllable
    • Most correlated with target

1.6 Recap
#

  • The most common methods to estimate multiple regression parameters are ordinary least square(Loss Function) and optimization with random values(Gradient Descent)

item.title: Coursera - IBM Ai Engineering 02
item.author: archyz_studio@163.com (Archy Tseng)
item.description:
Today’s Study Notes :
#

1.Introduction to Regression Algorithms
#

1.1 Purpose for learning this course:
#

  • Define Regression
  • Compare simple and multiple regression
  • Explain applications of regression

1.2 Study Notes:
#

  • Regression Algorithms
    • Linear and polynomial
    • Random forest
    • Extreme Gradient Boosting(XGBoost)
    • K-nearest neighpbors(KNN)
    • Support vector machines(SVM)
    • Neural network
  • Recap
    • Regression is a machine learning technique
      • Models the relationship between continuous target variables and explanatory features
    • In simple regession, a single independent variable estimates a dependent variable(can be linear or nonlinear)
    • In multiple regession, multiple independent variables estimate a dependent variable(can be linear or nonlinear)
    • Regression can be used to:
      • Forecast sales
      • Predict maintenance
      • Estimate rainfall
      • Predict the spread of infectious disease(传染病)

2.Introduction to Simple Linear Regression
#

2.1 Purpose for learning this course:
#

  • Describe simple linear regression
  • Explain how simple linear regression works

2.2 Study Notes:
#

  • Linear regression formula:
    • \(y^{hat} = \theta_0 + \theta_1 x_1\)
  • MSE : mean squeared error
    • commonly known as ordinary least squares regression(OLS, 普通最小二乘法回归)
  • Pros and Cons
    • Pros : Simple and easy to understand
    • Cons : its accuracy can be greatly reduced by outliers

item.title: Coursera - IBM Ai Engineering Module 1 - unit 1
item.author: archyz_studio@163.com (Archy Tseng)
item.description:
1.What can I get from this course?
#

  • This PC is specifically designed to help you build the practical experience employers look for. Throughout the program, you’ll apply your skills in hands-on labs and projects that fine-tune your new competencies. You’ll:
    • Build deep learning models and neural networks using Keras, PyTorch, and TensorFlow.
      学会通过Keras, PyTorch, TensorFlow来创建深度学习模型和神经网络。
    • Implement supervised and unsupervised machine learning models using SciPy and Scikit-Learn, positional encoding, masking, attention mechanism, and document classification.
      通过使用 SciPy, Scikit-Learn, 位置编码，掩蔽，注意力机制和文档分类来学习应用有监督和无监督机器学习模型。
    • Create LLMs like GPT and BERT.
      创建一个类似 GPT 和 BERT 的大语言模型。
    • Develop transfer learning applications in NLP using major language model frameworks like LangChain, Hugging Face, & PyTorch.
      使用主流语言模型框架（比如 LangChain, Hugging Face, PyTorch）开发 迁移学习应用。
    • Set up a Gradio interface for model interaction and construct a QA bot using LangChain and LLM to answer questions from loaded documents.
      搭建一个 Gradio 界面实现模型交互，并借助 LangChain 和大语言模型（LLM）构建问答机器人，用于回答从已加载文档中提取的问题。

2.What is the structure of the Course?
#

  • 01-Machine Learning with Python
  • 02-Introduction Deep Learning & Neural Networks with Keras
  • 03-Deep Learning with Keras and TensorFlow
  • 04-Introduction to Neural Networks and PyTorch
  • 05-Deep Learning with PyTorch
  • 06-AI Capstone Project with Deep Learning
  • 07-Generative AI and LLMs: Architecture and Data Preparation
  • 08-Gen AI Foundational Models for NLP & Language Understanding
  • 09-Generative AI Language Modeling with Transformers
  • 10-Generative AI Engineering and Fine-Tuning Transformers
  • 11-Generative AI Advanced Fine-Tuning For LLMs
  • 12-Foundamentals of AI Agents Using RAG and LangChain
  • 13-Project: Generative AI Applications with RAG and LangChain

3.My Study Plan
#

  • Entire Study Plan: 6 weeks
    • Week 1: 06.03 - 06.08
      • Module 01 - 03
    • Week 2: 06.09 - 06.15
      • Module 04 - 06
    • Week 3: 06.16 - 06.22
      • Module 07 - 08
    • Week 4: 06.23 - 06.29
      • Module 09 - 11
    • Week 5: 06.30 - 07.06
      • Module 12 - 13
    • Week 6: 07.07 - 07.13
      • For unexpected Plan changes

4.Today’s Study
#

  • Modul Name: Introduction to Machine Learning
  • Learn the overview of Machine Learning with Python
    • Python and its Libraries : Numpy, Pandas, Matplotlib, SciPy, Scikit-Learn
    • Machine Learning lifecycle:
      • Problem Definition
      • Data Collection
      • Data Preparation
      • Model Development and Evaluation
      • Model Deployment
    • The differences between Data scientists and AI engineering:
      • Data Type: structured data vs unstructured data
      • Use Case: EDA(Exploration Data Analysis) vs Dicision Optimisation
      • Model Feature: various kinds of models with small scap and smaller parameter size vs foundational model of large scap and large parameter size
      • Process speed: Second ~ Hour vs Days ~ Months
